3. Title Suit No. 9 of 1989 was filed seeking declaration that the plaintiffs have the share to the extent of 5/9 in the suit land and for further declaration that the defendant No. 1 is not the legally married wife of late Jamshad Ali. In Title Suit No. 95 of 1994 (filed by the heirs of Jamshed Ali) relief was sought for recovery of khas possession evicting the defendants from the land in suit and for declaration of title. 

 5. The case of the plaintiffs of the Suit No. 95 of 1994 is that late Jamshed Ali, the husband of plaintiff No.1, with his own money purchased the land in suit and the plaintiff No. 1 is his legally married wife and out of their wedlock there are six (6) children. That Jahir Ali and Jamir Ali are the brothers of late Jamshed Ali and they taking advantage of the death of late Jamshed Ali denying the title of the plaintiffs and refused to vacate the building in question and hence the suit for declaration of title and recovery of khas possession.
